name: Doc2MD
description: A mixed-modality benchmark for faithful PDF-to-Markdown reconstruction across long regulated packets, full-page scans, native text, visual evidence, source precedence, spatial relations, and genuine malformed office exports.

cases.title: Dense tables, scans, and correction chains
cases.purpose: Measures whether a model can exhaustively rebuild dense tables, equations, plots, scanned forms, continued records, and a correction trail that changes the controlling value without dropping bindings or qualifiers.
cases.sourceModality: 6 native pages, 3 raster pages, and 3 mixed pages; native text and page vision are both required

cases.title: Spatial diagrams, topology, and cross-page bindings
cases.purpose: Measures whether a model preserves two-dimensional relationships, overlays, directed paths, component bindings, table and form state, scanned annotations, and controlling-versus-archived evidence as consumable Markdown.
cases.sourceModality: 5 native pages, 2 full-page scans, and 3 mixed pages combining native structures with raster evidence

cases.title: Long-context state tracking across 48 pages
cases.purpose: Measures whether a model maintains entities and controlling state across continued logs, scanned forms, corrections, delayed follow-up evidence, repeated identifiers, and tail pages without summarizing away detail.
cases.sourceModality: 28 native pages, 12 full-page scans, and 8 mixed pages with embedded raster regions

cases.title: Visual evidence, coordinate binding, and final-state recovery
cases.purpose: Measures whether a model joins image evidence, coordinate maps, charts, structured records, form states, conflicting sources, and final authorization while preserving exact entity-to-value bindings.
cases.sourceModality: native records, 2 full-page scans, synthetic inspection imagery, and scanned forms

cases.title: Broken-layout and native-layer recovery
cases.family: malformed export recovery and reading order
cases.purpose: Measures whether a model reconstructs logical reading order after font substitution, overlapping boxes, detached labels, shuffled PDF objects, and mixed native and raster evidence.
cases.sourceModality: a 5-page malformed office export; native text, raster evidence, and object coordinates each supply incomplete pieces

provenance.ingestionMode: candidate-specific; see each inference.json and configured candidate

costMethodology.comparison: Hosted and hybrid candidates use published production list price applied to provider-reported billable tokens or credits; free tiers and promotional credits are ignored. Local candidates have zero conversion-API cost.
costMethodology.actualSpend: Provider-reported cache reads and configured cache-write rates are retained for operational accounting but do not discount the normalized comparison cost.

exclusions.reason: No complete draw has a valid score for the current scorer and corpus.
